basic_info.description: Beautifully renovated split-level home on a quiet street in Miraloma Park. Stylish interior finishes & thoughtful updates throughout. Bright & welcoming. Truly casual elegance at its best! The perfect balance of sophistication & comfort makes you feel at home the moment you enter. Functional floor-plan & gracious proportions offer ideal flexibility for living & entertainment. Top level includes 3BD & 2 stylishly designed BA. Delightfully updated Kitchen is the heart of the home filled w/ freshness, tranquility & warmth. Spacious Living Rm w/ dapper & cozy fireplace & expansive Dining area for entertaining. Wonderful for dinner parties, family gatherings & holiday celebrations. A few steps down, a generous Family Rm w/ flexible space to unwind & play: movie nights, home office, art studio & all your creative adventures. Chic Powder Rm & Laundry Rm complete this level. Enjoy the lush private Patio - a freshly landscaped outdoor oasis perfect for BBQs, lounging w/ a favorite book, enjoying a refreshing cocktail while your kids & furry friends frolic, & hosting outdoor parties. 2-car Garage + off-street PKG. Close to shopping, dining, parks, schools & fwy/transit. Interior design by Marian Vlahos. Landscape design by Alexander Nurseries. Don't miss this serene city retreat!
